self.id=0\n    def _post(self, method, params=None, notify=False):\n        h={\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Accept\":\"application/json, text/event-stream\"}\n        if self.sid: h[\"Mcp-Session-Id\"]=self.sid\n        b={\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method}\n        if not notify:\n            self.id+=1; b[\"id\"]=self.id\n        if params is not None: b[\"params\"]=params\n        req=urllib.request.Request(URL,data=json.dumps(b).encode(),headers=h,method=\"POST\")\n        r=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30)\n        s=r.headers.get(\"Mcp-Session-Id\")\n        if s: self.sid=s\n        raw=r.read(); ct=r.headers.get(\"Content-Type\",\"\")\n        if \"text/event-stream\" in ct:\n            parts=[]\n            for line in raw.decode().splitlines():\n                if line.startswith(\"data:\"): parts.append(line[5:].strip())\n            raw=\"\\n\".join(parts).encode()\n        return json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else None\n    def init(self):\n        self._post(\"initialize\",{\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{},\"clientInfo\":{\"name\":\"c\",\"version\":\"0\"}})\n        self._post(\"notifications/initialized\",{},notify=True)\n    def tool(self, name, args=None):\n        r=self._post(\"tools/call\",{\"name\":name,\"arguments\":args or {}})\n        return r\ndef parse_render(res):\n    # res is jsonrpc result: {content:[{type:text,text:caption},{type:image,data:..,mimeType}...]}\n    out={\"caption\":None,\"images\":[]}\n    content=res[\"result\"][\"content\"]\n    for c in content:\n        if c.get(\"type\")==\"text\":\n            out[\"caption\"]=json.loads(c[\"text\"])\n        elif c.get(\"type\")==\"image\":\n            img=np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(c[\"data\"]))))\n            out[\"images\"].append(img)\n    return out\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys; {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679823288,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_ee3a8d8651c44d75b8207a78","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/opencode')\nfrom mcp import C,parse_render\nfrom geo import backproject\nimport numpy as np,pickle\nc=C();c.init()\nallb=[];alla=[]\nviews=[(\"iso\",None,None),(\"front\",None,None),(\"back\",None,None),(\"side\",None,None),(\"top\",None,None)]\nfor v,az,el in views:\n    r=c.tool(\"render\",{\"view\":v,\"modalities\":[\"depth\",\"segmentation\"],\"depth_format\":\"metric\",\"width\":800,\"height\":600,\"lookat\":[1.2,0.4,0.2],\"distance\":4.5})\n    o=parse_render(r);cap=o[\"caption\"];dep=o[\"images\"][0];seg=o[\"images\"][1]\n    pts=backproject(cap,dep,seg)\n    mb=np.all(seg==[40,110,230],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    ma=np.all(seg==[150,150,150],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    allb.append(pts[mb]);alla.append(pts[ma])\n    print(v,\"B\",mb.sum(),\"A\",ma.sum())\npb=np.concatenate(allb);pa=np.concatenate(alla)\n# voxel downsample\ndef vox(p,s=0.02):\n    q=np.round(p/s).astype(int)\n    _,idx=np.unique(q,axis=0,return_index=True)\n    return p[idx]\npb=vox(pb);pa=vox(pa)\nprint(\"merged B\",pb.shape,\"A\",pa.shape)\nnp.save(\"pb_all.npy\",pb);np.save(\"pa_all.npy\",pa)\nEOF"},"output":"iso B 22428 A 10572\nfront B 20968 A 9680\nback B 20183 A 22703\nside B 13483 A 20172\ntop B 27322 A 23838\nmerged B (10098, 3) A (9058, 3)\n","metadata":{"output":"iso B 22428 A 10572\nfront B 20968 A 9680\nback B 20183 A 22703\nside B 13483 A 20172\ntop B 27322 A 23838\nmerged B (10098, 3) A (9058, 3)\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679881264,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_4bb81f6717a84e6eaf89b161","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > plan.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R\nimport time, pickle\n\nbl=vox=lambda p,s: p[np.unique(np.round(p/s).astype(int),axis=0,return_index=True)[1]]\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")\nA=np.load(\"a_world.npy\")\nBf=vox(B,0.05); Af=vox(A,0.05)\ntreeA=cKDTree(Af)\nCOLL=0.03  # treat min dist < COLL as collision\nMARGIN=0.05\n\ndef transforms(pose):\n    p=pose[:3]; q=pose[3:]\n    return R.from_quat([q[1],q[2],q[3],q[0]]).as_matrix()\n\ndef min_dist(pose, pts=None):\n    Rm=transforms(pose)\n    bw=Bf@Rm.T+pose[:3]\n    d,_=treeA.query(bw,k=1)\n    return d.min()\n\ndef collide(pose, margin=COLL):\n    return min_dist(pose) < margin\n\ndef fk_pose(p,q):\n    return np.concatenate([p,q])\n\ndef qmul(a,b):\n    w1,x1,y1,z1=a;w2,x2,y2,z2=b\n    return np.array([w1*w2-x1*x2-y1*y2-z1*z2,\n                     w1*x2+x1*w2+y1*z2-z1*y2,\n                     w1*y2-x1*z2+y1*w2+z1*x2,\n                     w1*z2+x1*y2-y1*x2+z1*w2])\ndef qnorm(q): return q/np.linalg.norm(q)\n\ndef rand_pose(anchor, maxrot=0.6, cell=0.25, rotscale=0.5):\n    # sample near anchor\n    dp=np.random.randn(3)*cell\n    dq=R.from_rotvec(np.random.randn(3)*rotscale).as_quat() # xyzw\n    dq4=np.array([dq[3],dq[0],dq[1],dq[2]])\n    p=anchor[:3]+dp\n    q=qnorm(qmul(anchor[3:],dq4))\n    return np.concatenate([p,q])\n\ndef interp(pa,pb,t):\n    p=pa[:3]+(pb[:3]-pa[:3])*t\n    # slerp\n    qa=R.from_quat([pa[3],pa[4],pa[5],pa[6]])\n    qb=R.from_quat([pb[3],pb[4],pb[5],pb[6]])\n    from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp\n    sl=Slerp([0,1],R.concatenate([qa,qb]))\n    q=sl(t).as_quat()\n    return np.concatenate([p,[q[3],q[0],q[1],q[2]]])\n\ndef edge_free(pa,pb,steps=8):\n    for i in range(1,steps+1):\n        if collide(interp(pa,pb,i/steps)): return False\n    return True\nEOF\necho ok"},"output":"ok\n","metadata":{"output":"ok\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > plan.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R\nimport time, pickle\n\nbl=vox=lambda p,s: p[np.unique(np.round(p/s).astype(int),axis=0,return_index=True)[1]]\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")\nA=np.load(\"a_world.npy\")\nBf=vox(B,0.05); Af=vox(A,0.05)\ntreeA=cKDTree(Af)\nCOLL=0.03  # treat min dist < COLL as collision\nMARGIN=0.05\n\ndef transforms(pose):\n    p=pose[:3]; q=pose[3:]\n    return R.from_quat([q[1],q[2],q[3],q[0]]).as_matrix()\n\ndef min_dist(pose, pts=None):\n    Rm=transforms(pose)\n    bw=Bf@Rm.T+pose[:3]\n    d,_=treeA.query(bw,k=1)\n    return d.min()\n\ndef collide(pose, margin=COLL):\n    return min_dist(pose) < margin\n\ndef fk_pose(p,q):\n    return np.concatenate([p,q])\n\ndef qmul(a,b):\n    w1,x1,y1,z1=a;w2,x2,y2,z2=b\n    return np.array([w1*w2-x1*x2-y1*y2-z1*z2,\n                     w1*x2+x1*w2+y1*z2-z1*y2,\n                     w1*y2-x1*z2+y1*w2+z1*x2,\n                     w1*z2+x1*y2-y1*x2+z1*w2])\ndef qnorm(q): return q/np.linalg.norm(q)\n\ndef rand_pose(anchor, maxrot=0.6, cell=0.25, rotscale=0.5):\n    # sample near anchor\n    dp=np.random.randn(3)*cell\n    dq=R.from_rotvec(np.random.randn(3)*rotscale).as_quat() # xyzw\n    dq4=np.array([dq[3],dq[0],dq[1],dq[2]])\n    p=anchor[:3]+dp\n    q=qnorm(qmul(anchor[3:],dq4))\n    return np.concatenate([p,q])\n\ndef interp(pa,pb,t):\n    p=pa[:3]+(pb[:3]-pa[:3])*t\n    # slerp\n    qa=R.from_quat([pa[3],pa[4],pa[5],pa[6]])\n    qb=R.from_quat([pb[3],pb[4],pb[5],pb[6]])\n    from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp\n    sl=Slerp([0,1],R.concatenate([qa,qb]))\n    q=sl(t).as_quat()\n    return np.concatenate([p,[q[3],q[0],q[1],q[2]]])\n\ndef edge_free(pa,pb,steps=8):\n    for i in range(1,steps+1):\n        if collide(interp(pa,pb,i/steps)): return False\n    return True\nEOF\necho ok","time":{"start":1794679881243,"end":1794679881260}},"id":"prt_1db41be140011DziEsdfWlcvsq","sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","messageID":"msg_1db41ae71001U6dI4cm84T0dWq"}}

Let me set up a scripted loop that:\n1. builds fine distance model,\n2. at each step tries a set of candidate 6-DOF moves, picks the one maximizing real clearance gain / progress, executes via sim, checks blocked & success.\n\nBut \"real clearance\" I can't get directly (contacts only give near-contact). I can rely on `blocked` and success.\n\nGiven the complexity and that I can now render+process images freely, the best investment is a **good geometric model + real planner**. Let me build the model as **voxel occupancy of each tube's solid** by inflating the surface cloud to fill the tube (local PCA radius). Then use occupancy-grid collision (fast, robust to sampling noise, models volume).\n\nLet me estimate tube radius more carefully by looking at surface point normals: For a tube of radius r, doubling: the surface is a swept circle. The distance between opposite surface walls across the tube = 2r. Take a point, find nearest opposite wall. Let me compute the thickness distribution = for each point, distance to nearest surface point on the opposite side (2r). Hard.\n\nAlternative: I'll just trust surface-point distance with an empirically calibrated bias and run RRT with COLL small, then verify each segment on the real sim and only keep verified ones. Since verification actions are the budget, I should plan a *short* path.\n\nLet me first measure the model bias precisely: at the known contacting pose, real penetration=0.00046 (essentially 0 clearance) and model min_dist=? Let me recompute at that exact pose with dense cloud.\n\nActually current pose is essentially that contacting pose (last action blocked). Model min_dist=0.0064 there. So bias ≈ 0.0064 (real 0). So collision iff model_dist < ~0.0064. Set COLL=0.008.\n\nLet me rerun start-push and RRT with COLL=0.008 but keep a safety by requiring edges have model_dist ≥ 0.008, i.e., real ≥ ~0.0015 clearance. Thin but real. And verify each real segment.\n\nWait, that's too thin for 0-penetration audit. Real audit likely penalizes any interpenetration > tolerance. 1.5mm might be under tolerance. Let me keep margin where possible.\n\nLet me reconsider: perhaps I should get an accurate model by reconstructing actual meshes. The depth images give accurate metric depth. The surface points are accurate to ~mm. The bias comes from point sampling density (nn ~8mm) — meaning between two surfaces 5mm apart, nearest sampled point might be 5mm away. With denser sampling (nn ~3mm), bias drops to ~3mm. Let me sample at higher resolution to reduce bias.","time":{"start":1794679918059,"end":1794679920909}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794679926934,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_cb64c6bbab0648129764d940","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/opencode')\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")\n# local thickness: for each pt, PCA normal, then find the tube axis distance? \n# Simpler: histogram of nearest-neighbor distances in a small region\nt=cKDTree(B)\ndef region(center,r=0.2):\n    m=np.linalg.norm(B-center,axis=1)<r\n    return B[m]\n# pick region near a straightish part\nfor ctr in [[1.0,0,0],[-0.8,0.2,0],[0,0.3,0]]:\n    sub=region(np.array(ctr))\n    if len(sub)<50: \n        print(ctr,\"few\");continue\n    cc=sub.mean(0);u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(sub-cc,full_matrices=False)\n    print(ctr,\"n\",len(sub),\"extent\",np.ptp(sub,axis=0).round(2),\"sv\",s.round(2))\nEOF"},"output":"[1.0, 0, 0] n 115 extent [0.18 0.1  0.06] sv [0.51 0.31 0.04]\n[-0.8, 0.2, 0] n 1142 extent [0.34 0.35 0.3 ] sv [3.15 2.57 2.22]\n[0, 0.3, 0] n 481 extent [0.34 0.26 0.37] sv [3.01 1.31 1.1 ]\n","metadata":{"output":"[1.0, 0, 0] n 115 extent [0.18 0.1  0.06] sv [0.51 0.31 0.04]\n[-0.8, 0.2, 0] n 1142 extent [0.34 0.35 0.3 ] sv [3.15 2.57 2.22]\n[0, 0.3, 0] n 481 extent [0.34 0.26 0.37] sv [3.01 1.31 1.1 ]\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/opencode')\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")\n# local thickness: for each pt, PCA normal, then find the tube axis distance? \n# Simpler: histogram of nearest-neighbor distances in a small region\nt=cKDTree(B)\ndef region(center,r=0.2):\n    m=np.linalg.norm(B-center,axis=1)<r\n    return B[m]\n# pick region near a straightish part\nfor ctr in [[1.0,0,0],[-0.8,0.2,0],[0,0.3,0]]:\n    sub=region(np.array(ctr))\n    if len(sub)<50: \n        print(ctr,\"few\");continue\n    cc=sub.mean(0);u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(sub-cc,full_matrices=False)\n    print(ctr,\"n\",len(sub),\"extent\",np.ptp(sub,axis=0).round(2),\"sv\",s.round(2))\nEOF","time":{"start":1794679926173,"end":1794679926929}},"id":"prt_1db426d8e001emn78WvxDBntg1","sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","messageID":"msg_1db4264ac001N6TxyI4RxSqBkC"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794680028063,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_327a79258e8f41bfa1ca1020","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/opencode')\nfrom mcp import C,parse_render\nfrom geo import backproject\nimport numpy as np\nc=C();c.init()\nallb=[];alla=[]\nlookat=[1.2,0.4,0.2]\nfor az in list(range(0,360,20)):\n  for el in [-55,-15,25,65]:\n    r=c.tool(\"render\",{\"azimuth\":az,\"elevation\":el,\"modalities\":[\"depth\",\"segmentation\"],\"depth_format\":\"metric\",\"width\":1280,\"height\":960,\"lookat\":lookat,\"distance\":3.0})\n    o=parse_render(r);cap=o[\"caption\"];dep=o[\"images\"][0];seg=o[\"images\"][1]\n    pts=backproject(cap,dep,seg)\n    mb=np.all(seg==[40,110,230],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    ma=np.all(seg==[150,150,150],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    allb.append(pts[mb]);alla.append(pts[ma])\nprint(\"captured\")\npb=np.concatenate(allb);pa=np.concatenate(alla)\nprint(\"raw B\",pb.shape,\"A\",pa.shape)\ndef vox(p,s):\n    q=np.round(p/s).astype(int);_,idx=np.unique(q,axis=0,return_index=True);return p[idx]\nfor s in [0.004,0.006]:\n    print(s,len(vox(pb,s)),len(vox(pa,s)))\nnp.save(\"pb_hr.npy\",pb);np.save(\"pa_hr.npy\",pa)\nEOF"},"output":"captured\nraw B (8862385, 3) A (9518054, 3)\n0.004 320833 319082\n0.006 143425 137082\n","metadata":{"output":"captured\nraw B (8862385, 3) A (9518054, 3)\n0.004 320833 319082\n0.006 143425 137082\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys;sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/opencode')\nfrom mcp import C,parse_render\nfrom geo import backproject\nimport numpy as np\nc=C();c.init()\nallb=[];alla=[]\nlookat=[1.2,0.4,0.2]\nfor az in list(range(0,360,20)):\n  for el in [-55,-15,25,65]:\n    r=c.tool(\"render\",{\"azimuth\":az,\"elevation\":el,\"modalities\":[\"depth\",\"segmentation\"],\"depth_format\":\"metric\",\"width\":1280,\"height\":960,\"lookat\":lookat,\"distance\":3.0})\n    o=parse_render(r);cap=o[\"caption\"];dep=o[\"images\"][0];seg=o[\"images\"][1]\n    pts=backproject(cap,dep,seg)\n    mb=np.all(seg==[40,110,230],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    ma=np.all(seg==[150,150,150],axis=-1)&(dep>0)\n    allb.append(pts[mb]);alla.append(pts[ma])\nprint(\"captured\")\npb=np.concatenate(allb);pa=np.concatenate(alla)\nprint(\"raw B\",pb.shape,\"A\",pa.shape)\ndef vox(p,s):\n    q=np.round(p/s).astype(int);_,idx=np.unique(q,axis=0,return_index=True);return p[idx]\nfor s in [0.004,0.006]:\n    print(s,len(vox(pb,s)),len(vox(pa,s)))\nnp.save(\"pb_hr.npy\",pb);np.save(\"pa_hr.npy\",pa)\nEOF","time":{"start":1794679932140,"end":1794680028044}},"id":"prt_1db4284dd001NzBkgY2KFeiDBW","sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","messageID":"msg_1db4270c6001JuCajG1q1HwiHm"}}

<<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np,time\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R\ng=np.load(\"A_grid5.npz\");lo=g[\"lo\"];res=float(g[\"res\"]);dims=g[\"dims\"];dist=g[\"dist\"]\nBl=np.load(\"B_local_coarse.npy\")\nprint(\"Bl\",Bl.shape)\ndef sdf(pts):\n    i=np.floor((pts-lo)/res).astype(int);i=np.clip(i,0,dims-1)\n    return dist[i[:,0],i[:,1],i[:,2]]\ndef mind(pose,B):\n    Rp=R.from_quat([pose[4],pose[5],pose[6],pose[3]]).as_matrix()\n    return float(sdf(B@Rp.T+pose[:3]).min())\npos=np.load(\"pose_b.npy\");q=np.load(\"quat_b.npy\");cur=np.concatenate([pos,q])\nfor n in [36096,8000,4000]:\n    idx=np.random.RandomState(0).choice(len(Bl),n,replace=False)\n    B=Bl[idx]\n    t=time.time()\n    for _ in range(200):mind(cur,B)\n    print(n,\"ms/call\",round((time.time()-t)/200*1000,3),\"mind\",round(mind(cur,B),3))\nEOF"},"output":"Bl (36096, 3)\n36096 ms/call 2.726 mind 0.0\n8000 ms/call 0.422 mind 0.0\n4000 ms/call 0.214 mind 0.005\n","metadata":{"output":"Bl (36096, 3)\n36096 ms/call 2.726 mind 0.0\n8000 ms/call 0.422 mind 0.0\n4000 ms/call 0.214 mind 0.005\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np,time\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R\ng=np.load(\"A_grid5.npz\");lo=g[\"lo\"];res=float(g[\"res\"]);dims=g[\"dims\"];dist=g[\"dist\"]\nBl=np.load(\"B_local_coarse.npy\")\nprint(\"Bl\",Bl.shape)\ndef sdf(pts):\n    i=np.floor((pts-lo)/res).astype(int);i=np.clip(i,0,dims-1)\n    return dist[i[:,0],i[:,1],i[:,2]]\ndef mind(pose,B):\n    Rp=R.from_quat([pose[4],pose[5],pose[6],pose[3]]).as_matrix()\n    return float(sdf(B@Rp.T+pose[:3]).min())\npos=np.load(\"pose_b.npy\");q=np.load(\"quat_b.npy\");cur=np.concatenate([pos,q])\nfor n in [36096,8000,4000]:\n    idx=np.random.RandomState(0).choice(len(Bl),n,replace=False)\n    B=Bl[idx]\n    t=time.time()\n    for _ in range(200):mind(cur,B)\n    print(n,\"ms/call\",round((time.time()-t)/200*1000,3),\"mind\",round(mind(cur,B),3))\nEOF","time":{"start":1794680617451,"end":1794680618965}},"id":"prt_1db4cf9e6001lUqw37zmTqf6h5","sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","messageID":"msg_1db4cf53f0018Fb9tadUFCdg0n"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794681029838,"sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_149cc6e8b23d4b0f97cf9b16","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")  # local shape (from earlier pose)\nprint(\"B\",B.shape)\n# estimate normals via local PCA\ntree=cKDTree(B)\nd,idx=tree.query(B,k=12)\n# normals\nnrm=np.zeros_like(B)\nfor i in range(0,len(B),1):\n    nb=B[idx[i]]\n    c=nb-nb.mean(0)\n    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(c,full_matrices=False)\n    nrm[i]=vt[2]\n# orient normals outward: away from centroid\ncen=B.mean(0)\nout=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',nrm,B-cen)\nnrm[out<0]*=-1\nnp.save(\"bnormals.npy\",nrm)\nprint(\"normals done\")\nEOF"},"output":"B (21720, 3)\nnormals done\n","metadata":{"output":"B (21720, 3)\nnormals done\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nB=np.load(\"b_local.npy\")  # local shape (from earlier pose)\nprint(\"B\",B.shape)\n# estimate normals via local PCA\ntree=cKDTree(B)\nd,idx=tree.query(B,k=12)\n# normals\nnrm=np.zeros_like(B)\nfor i in range(0,len(B),1):\n    nb=B[idx[i]]\n    c=nb-nb.mean(0)\n    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(c,full_matrices=False)\n    nrm[i]=vt[2]\n# orient normals outward: away from centroid\ncen=B.mean(0)\nout=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',nrm,B-cen)\nnrm[out<0]*=-1\nnp.save(\"bnormals.npy\",nrm)\nprint(\"normals done\")\nEOF","time":{"start":1794681029131,"end":1794681029836}},"id":"prt_1db5341fb001GGkt57OPhz45oS","sessionID":"ses_e24c0764cffeLy9Rd3MGclJBWk","messageID":"msg_1db5332aa001FPFeTFqwXxBH04"}}
